author: Dr. Vijay Srinivas Agneeswaran
html: Thanks for your comments Jithendra. While it remains to be seen if TrueTime API will be opensourced, there is already something available in the open source: Cockroach DB. CockroachDB is interesting, as it provides ACID properties at scale similar to Google Spanner (it provides Serilizability and not Linearizability that is provided by Spanner).
